command:
cmake --build --preset windows-msvc-x64-debug --target ForgeConductor.Contracts.ContractTests ForgeConductor.Continuity.DocumentCodecTests ForgeConductor.Continuity.CoordinatorTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.CatalogCodecTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.ExecutionServicesTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.ToolRouterTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.InvocationGuardTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.ToolPackAdapterTests -- /m
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
ctest --preset windows-msvc-x64-debug -R "^(ForgeConductor\.Mcp\.(CatalogCodec|ExecutionServices|ToolRouter|InvocationGuard|ToolPackAdapter)Tests|ForgeConductor\.Continuity\.(DocumentCodec|Coordinator)Tests|ForgeConductor\.Contracts\.ContractTests)$" --output-on-failure
exit $LASTEXITCODE
